description: Use this policy setting if you want to disable the display of Windows Defender Security Center notifications. If you disable or do not configure this setting, Windows Defender Security Center notifications will display on devices. Value type is integer. Supported operations are Add, Get, Replace and Delete.

options.displayName: (Disable) The users can see the display of Windows Defender Security Center notifications.
options.description: (Disable) The users can see the display of Windows Defender Security Center notifications.

options.displayName: (Enable) The users cannot see the display of Windows Defender Security Center notifications.
options.description: (Enable) The users cannot see the display of Windows Defender Security Center notifications.
